# guest

The `HostAccountSource` host service of a host without the computer (the
browser composition): a fixed account — login `demo`, full name "Alex Morgan" —
so the Pages brand ("Alex's pages", the `A` tile) renders as it does on the
desktop. The desktop provides the service from `host-account#machine`, reading
the OS account; this plugin is excluded from every desktop app by the
composition config's base-exclusions row (two providers of one service fail
boot).

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The account of a host without the computer: provides the HostAccountSource host service as a fixed guest account (login `demo`, full name Alex Morgan), so a surface that greets the user — the Pages brand — renders as it does on the desktop (the browser composition, the portable boot test). Never booted by the desktop.
- Excluded: yes
- Server:
  - Contributes: `host-service:host-account.source` "host-account.source"
  - Uses: `infra/host-account.HostAccountSource`
